name: Top risks with an owner and an approved treatment plan (%)
definition: Share of top risks (R-01 to R-15, plus any risk added at or above the threshold in document 11) that have a named executive owner and a treatment plan that owner has approved, with dated actions.
formula: Top risks with a named executive owner and an approved, dated treatment plan / all top risks x 100, at month end
data_source: Risk register (data/risk-register.csv and its working copy); treatment approvals recorded in Quarterly Risk Review minutes
cadence: Measured monthly; reported on the monthly executive scorecard and at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: every top risk has a named owner by M2; 100 percent by M3 and every month after
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review; board summary at the CEO's discretion

name: Policies reviewed within their cycle (%)
definition: Share of policies POL-01 to POL-15 that have a recorded owner review sign-off in the last 12 months and whose latest approval falls within the substantive rewrite cycle that policy states (document 10). Approval at M3 counts as each policy's first owner review.
formula: Policies with an owner review sign-off in the last 12 months and an approval within their stated rewrite cycle / policies in the set x 100, at month end
data_source: Policy register in the compliance automation platform (ADR-007, category only) or the controlled document library: owner, approval date, rewrite cycle, and the date of the last owner review sign-off
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: 100 percent from M3, when the executive team approves the policy set; no policy overdue by more than 30 days
audience: Quarterly Risk Review; IT and Security Steering Group when a policy is overdue

name: SOC 2 controls operating without exceptions (%)
definition: Share of in-scope SOC 2 controls whose most recent test found no exception. Two views are reported side by side and never blended: the SOC 2 audit firm's results in its latest report, and management's own control testing between reports.
formula: Controls tested with no exception / controls tested x 100, for each view
data_source: Latest SOC 2 Type II report; management control testing records in the compliance automation platform (ADR-007); the readiness tracker until the platform is live
cadence: Management view measured monthly; audit firm view updated when each report is issued; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: no new exceptions caused by the Director's changes in the review period closing at M4 (end of March 2027); management testing at 95 percent or better from Phase 4 and 98 percent by M7
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review; board summary at the CEO's discretion

name: Open audit exceptions and their median age
definition: Exceptions raised by the SOC 2 audit firm or by management's control testing that are not yet remediated and retested, with the median number of days since each was raised.
formula: Count of open exceptions at month end; median of (month-end date minus date raised) in days across open exceptions
data_source: SOC 2 report and management responses; exception log in the compliance automation platform (ADR-007)
cadence: Measured monthly; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: every exception has an owner and a committed remediation date within 10 business days of being raised; median age under 60 days from Phase 4; none open past its committed date
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review

name: Third parties handling customer or employee data with a current review (%)
definition: Share of third parties that store, process, or can access customer or employee data whose security review is current under POL-10. Review depth and interval follow data access and business criticality (document 10).
formula: In-scope third parties with a review completed within their review interval / in-scope third parties in the vendor inventory x 100, at month end
data_source: Vendor inventory with data access and review dates (document 10); finance system vendor list and contracts as the completeness check
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: 100 percent of third parties with customer data access by month 9 (July 2027); 90 percent of all in-scope third parties by M7
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: Devices managed in Intune out of devices known (%)
definition: Share of corporate-owned computers, phones, and tablets that are enrolled in Microsoft Intune and checked in within the last 30 days. Personal phones protected by app protection without enrollment are excluded.
formula: Enrolled devices that checked in within 30 days / devices in the reconciled inventory x 100, at month end
data_source: Intune device inventory (Intune Plan 1, included in Microsoft 365 E3); denominator reconciled from Intune, Microsoft Entra device records, Defender for Endpoint, and IT hardware partner purchase records (document 05)
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: 90 percent by the end of Phase 4 (April 2027) and 98 percent by M7; every unmanaged device has a dated exception
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: SaaS applications behind single sign-on (%)
definition: Share of software as a service (SaaS) applications in the application inventory that sign users in through Microsoft Entra single sign-on, reported for all inventoried applications and for those that hold customer or employee data.
formula: Inventoried SaaS applications with Microsoft Entra single sign-on enforced / inventoried SaaS applications x 100, for each view
data_source: Application inventory (document 15); Microsoft Entra enterprise applications; from Phase 4, Defender for Cloud Apps cloud discovery (in Microsoft Defender Suite) and queries/q05-app-consent-grants.kql to find applications missing from the inventory
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: by M7, 90 percent of applications that hold customer or employee data and 70 percent of all inventoried applications (document 15 sets the order)
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: Phishing-resistant MFA coverage, admins and all users (%)
definition: Share of each population (administrator accounts; all employees) that an enforced Conditional Access policy requires to sign in with a phishing-resistant multifactor authentication (MFA) strength (CA-02, CA-04, and CA-05 in document 06) and that has a phishing-resistant method registered. Registration alone is reported beside it as readiness.
formula: Accounts in scope of an enforced phishing-resistant policy with a registered phishing-resistant method / accounts in the population x 100, for administrators and for all employees
data_source: Conditional Access policy state and group membership (Microsoft Entra ID P1); Authentication methods activity, registration and usage, in the Microsoft Entra admin center (Microsoft states it requires Entra ID P1 or P2), which is the coverage source; sign-in logs; queries/q01-sign-ins-without-strong-auth.kql as a cross-check only, because it counts successful sign-ins that did not require MFA and does not measure phishing-resistant coverage
cadence: Measured monthly; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: administrators 100 percent by the end of Phase 2 (December 2026); the wave 2 group enforced in February 2027; all employees 90 percent by M6 (month 9, July 2027) and 95 percent by M7; no user relying only on SMS or voice after 2027-02-01
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review; board summary at the CEO's discretion

name: Standing privileged role assignments (count)
definition: Number of permanent active assignments to Microsoft Entra roles that Microsoft labels privileged (label in preview, as of 2026-10-13), including the two emergency access accounts. Eligible assignments activated just in time through Privileged Identity Management are not standing.
formula: Count of permanent active assignments to privileged roles at month end; Global Administrator assignments shown separately
data_source: Microsoft Entra admin center, Roles and administrators, Privileged column and assignments (Microsoft Entra ID, held at P1); Privileged Identity Management assignments from Phase 4 (Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft Entra ID Governance); queries/q03-privileged-role-changes.kql for changes between counts
cadence: Measured monthly; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: fewer than five Global Administrators, emergency access accounts included, by the end of Phase 1; fewer than 10 standing privileged assignments by the end of Phase 2 (Microsoft's guidance); 2, the emergency access accounts only, by the end of Phase 4 once Privileged Identity Management is licensed (ADR-001)
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review

name: Compliant devices (%)
definition: Share of Intune-managed corporate devices that meet their platform's Intune compliance policy: supported operating system version, disk encryption, Defender running with tamper protection, and firewall on (document 06).
formula: Managed devices reporting compliant / managed devices x 100, at month end
data_source: Intune device compliance status (Intune Plan 1); the tenant setting for devices with no compliance policy is recorded beside the value, because Microsoft's default marks them Compliant; queries/q07-windows-10-devices.kql lists Windows 10 devices still in service
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: 90 percent by the end of Phase 4, when CA-06 begins requiring compliant devices, and 97 percent by M7
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: Critical and high vulnerabilities fixed within target (%)
definition: Share of critical and high severity vulnerabilities on corporate endpoints closed within the deadline that POL-07 sets for their severity and asset importance, following the maintenance plan approach of NIST SP 800-40 Rev. 4. Engineering reports the product platform as a separate line under the shared RACI.
formula: Critical and high vulnerabilities remediated by their deadline / critical and high vulnerabilities whose deadline fell in the month x 100, for each line
data_source: Phases 1 to 3: operating system update currency from Intune, labeled interim. From Phase 4: vulnerability data from Defender for Endpoint Plan 2 (in Microsoft Defender Suite). Product: Engineering's scanner data, reported by the Engineering Manager
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: POL-07 deadlines of 14 days for critical and 30 days for high on corporate endpoints; 90 percent within deadline by M6 and 95 percent by M7; product targets set with Engineering
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: Leaver access removed within target (%)
definition: Leavers in the month whose Microsoft Entra ID account was disabled and sessions revoked within their service level (document 07), over all leavers; urgent leavers reported separately.
formula: Leavers disabled and with sessions revoked within their service level / all leavers in the month x 100
data_source: HR system of record leave and notice times; Lifecycle Workflows history (Microsoft Entra ID Governance) from Phase 4; Microsoft Entra audit log, archived beyond its 30-day window (document 08); ITSM tickets; queries/q06-stale-accounts.kql as a cross-check
cadence: Measured monthly; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: at least 98 percent from M6, and every urgent leaver within one hour (document 07); each miss reviewed with the GRC Analyst as a possible SOC 2 exception
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review

name: Access reviews completed on time (%)
definition: Review instances, scheduled and mover, closed by the due date with decisions applied, over all instances due (document 07).
formula: Review instances closed by their due date with decisions applied / review instances due in the period x 100
data_source: Microsoft Entra access reviews history (Microsoft Entra ID Governance); ITSM review tasks for manual reviews
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: 95 percent from the second automated review cycle (document 07)
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: Security training completion (%)
definition: Share of assigned security training modules (onboarding, awareness, and role-based) completed by their due date; the program and its cadence are in document 09.
formula: Assignments completed by their due date / assignments due in the period x 100; new-hire onboarding reported separately
data_source: Training platform completion records (document 09); HR system of record for the active employee population
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: 95 percent of assignments completed by their due date; every new hire completes onboarding security training in their first week (document 07)
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: Phishing simulation report rate and click rate
definition: For each simulation campaign, the share of recipients who reported the simulated message and the share who clicked it, read together and against the difficulty of the message.
formula: Report rate = recipients who reported / recipients x 100; click rate = recipients who clicked / recipients x 100
data_source: Attack simulation training results (Defender for Office 365 Plan 2, included in Microsoft Defender Suite or Microsoft 365 E5; E3 offers only a limited trial); difficulty rated with the NIST Phish Scale (NIST SP 800-50 Rev. 1)
cadence: Per campaign (document 09 sets the frequency); reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: against the first campaign at comparable difficulty, report rate up by at least half and click rate down by at least half by M7; no individual results in executive reports
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: Mean time to acknowledge and to contain high-severity incidents
definition: For SEV-1 and SEV-2 incidents (document 08): mean time from incident creation to acknowledgment by the managed detection and response (MDR) provider or on-call, and mean time from creation to the first containment action completed. Each incident's times are also listed.
formula: Mean of (acknowledged time minus created time) and mean of (first containment completed minus created time) across SEV-1 and SEV-2 incidents in the period
data_source: Microsoft Defender XDR incident records in the Defender portal (Microsoft lists Defender for Endpoint, and Microsoft 365 E3 with Microsoft Defender Suite, among the qualifying licenses); MDR case data; incident register in the ITSM tool (document 08); values before MDR go-live labeled interim
cadence: Measured monthly; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: from MDR go-live (end of Phase 4), acknowledgment within 15 minutes and containment within 4 hours, as means, at any hour; the MDR contract commits to times that support this (ADR-003)
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review; board summary at the CEO's discretion

name: Security incidents by severity and cause (count)
definition: Number of security incidents opened in the period, by severity (SEV-1 to SEV-4) and one cause each, using the cause list in document 08.
formula: Count of incidents opened in the period, grouped by severity and cause
data_source: Incident register in the ITSM tool (document 08)
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review, with SEV-1 and SEV-2 counts in the monthly scorecard note
target: Proposal: no target on the count, because fewer reports can mean less reporting; every incident classified by severity and cause within 5 business days of closure
audience: Quarterly Risk Review; SEV-1 and SEV-2 counts in the monthly scorecard note

name: Exercise and post-incident actions closed on time (%)
definition: Share of actions from exercises, after-action reports, and post-incident reviews closed by their due date.
formula: Actions due in the period closed by their due date / actions due in the period x 100
data_source: Action tracker in the ITSM tool (document 08)
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review and listed in the IT and Security Steering Group pre-read
target: Proposal: 90 percent from Phase 4; no action overdue by more than 30 days without a new date approved by the owning executive
audience: Quarterly Risk Review; IT and Security Steering Group pre-read

name: Restore tests meeting target recovery times (%)
definition: Share of restore and recovery tests run in the period that restored the data or service within the recovery time objective of its recovery class (document 14). Corporate tests and Engineering's product disaster recovery tests are separate lines; scheduled tests that did not run are listed.
formula: Tests that met their recovery class's recovery time objective / tests run in the period x 100, for each line
data_source: Restore test records (document 14) from the backup approach chosen in ADR-006; product disaster recovery test reports from the SRE lead
cadence: Per test (schedule in document 14); reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: every scheduled test run; 90 percent meet their recovery time objective from Phase 4; every miss gets a tracked action (KPI-18)
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review; board summary at the CEO's discretion

name: Service desk tickets resolved within target (%)
definition: Share of incidents and service requests resolved within the service level for their priority (document 13).
formula: Tickets resolved within their priority's service level / tickets resolved in the month x 100, by priority
data_source: IT service management (ITSM) tool
cadence: Measured monthly; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: 85 percent from Phase 3, once service levels are published (document 13), and 90 percent by M7
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review

name: Employee satisfaction with IT support (CSAT)
definition: Customer satisfaction score (CSAT): share of survey responses rating IT support 4 or 5 on a five-point scale, from the short survey sent when a ticket closes; response rate reported beside it.
formula: Responses rating 4 or 5 / all responses in the month x 100
data_source: ITSM tool post-resolution survey; a short pulse survey if the tool cannot survey (document 05)
cadence: Measured monthly; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: 90 percent by M7, with the response rate shown
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review

name: New hires fully productive on day one (%)
definition: New hires who by the end of day one have signed in with a phishing-resistant method (a passkey, Windows Hello for Business, or the macOS platform credential) on a compliant device and can use their birthright apps, over all new hires (document 07). Hires entered late in the HR system are flagged separately.
formula: New hires meeting all three conditions by the end of their first day / new hires who started in the month x 100
data_source: Lifecycle Workflows history (Microsoft Entra ID Governance); Intune compliance; the manager's day-two confirmation (document 07)
cadence: Measured monthly; reported monthly and quarterly
target: Proposal: 90 percent by M6 and 95 percent by M7 (document 07)
audience: Executive team (monthly scorecard); Quarterly Risk Review

name: Access requests fulfilled automatically (%)
definition: Access grants delivered with no manual IT step (automatic assignment, approved self-service, or provisioning through System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM)), over all grants including ticketed ones (document 07).
formula: Grants with no manual IT step / all grants in the month x 100
data_source: Microsoft Entra entitlement management and provisioning logs (Microsoft Entra ID Governance for automatic assignment); ITSM tickets
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: 60 percent by M6 and 75 percent by M7, depending on SCIM coverage (documents 07 and 15)
audience: Quarterly Risk Review

name: Corporate IT changes completed without incident or rollback (%)
definition: Share of corporate IT changes reviewed by the Change Advisory Board that were completed without causing an incident and without being rolled back. Product changes follow Engineering's change process and are out of scope.
formula: Corporate IT changes closed in the month with no linked incident and no rollback / corporate IT changes closed in the month x 100
data_source: ITSM change records and Change Advisory Board records (document 13); incident links in the ITSM tool
cadence: Measured monthly; reported at each Quarterly Risk Review
target: Proposal: 95 percent from Phase 3 and 97 percent by M7; emergency changes reported separately
audience: Quarterly Risk Review
